  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, dpi = 150, fig.width = 10)
source("settings.R")
require(ggplot2)
require(stringi)

dat <- readRDS(paste0(DIR_DATA, "/corpus/data_summary.rds"))
lis <- yaml::read_yaml(paste0("newsdata/sources.yaml"))
map <- rep(names(lis), lengths(lis))
names(map) <- unlist(lis)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
tb <- xtabs(total ~ source_id + year, dat)
dat_csv <- data.frame(source_id = rownames(tb), 
                      country = map[rownames(tb)],
                      as.data.frame.matrix(tb), 
                      total = rowSums(tb),
                      check.names = FALSE)
dat_csv <- dat_csv[order(dat_csv$country),]
rownames(dat_csv) <- NULL
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(dat_csv)
```

```{r}
write.csv(dat_csv, paste0(DIR_DATA, "/corpus/data_summary.csv"))
```
